plain_english: Men start calling women "mistresses" when they're just fourteen. When women see that men only value them for pleasure, they focus all their energy on looking attractive. That becomes their whole hope in life. So it's worth trying to help them understand something different: that they should be honored for their good character and modest virtue, not just their looks.
original_excerpt: Women from fourteen years old are flattered by men with the title of mistresses. Therefore, perceiving that they are regarded only as qualified to give men pleasure, they begin to adorn themselves, and in that to place all their hopes. It is worth while, therefore, to try that they may perceive themselves honored only so far as they appear beautiful in their demeanor and modestly virtuous.
